# [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN Comparison 2026

Choosing between NordVPN and ExpressVPN in 206 is one of the most common dilemmas for anyone serious about online privacy and security. Both are top-tier VPN services, but they cater to slightly different needs and budgets. In this detailed NordVPN vs ExpressVPN comparison 2026, we break down everything you need to know to make the right choice.

## Speed and Performance

### Raw Connection Speeds

Both providers deliver excellent speeds, but there are nuances. ExpressVPN has historically held a slight edge in raw throughput, especially on long-distance connections. Its proprietary Lightway protocol is incredibly efficient, offering near-instant connection times and minimal speed loss.

NordVPN counters with its NordLynx protocol, built on WireGuard technology. In our 2026 testing, NordLynx consistently delivered speeds within 5-10% of ExpressVPN's Lightway on most server locations. For everyday browsing, streaming, and even 4K video, both are more than sufficient.

### Server Network Size

NordVPN boasts a significantly larger server network with over 6,400 servers across 111 countries. ExpressVPN operates around 105 countries with a smaller but well-maintained server fleet. More servers generally mean less congestion and better performance during peak hours, giving NordVPN a practical advantage for users in less common locations.

## Security and Privacy

### Encryption Standards

Both services use AES-256 encryption, the industry gold standard. They also support modern protocols like WireGuard (NordLynx for NordVPN, Lightway for ExpressVPN), which offer better performance without compromising security.

### No-Logs Policies

This is where things get interesting. ExpressVPN is based in the British Virgin Islands, outside the jurisdiction of intelligence-sharing alliances like Five Eyes or Fourteen Eyes. NordVPN operates from Panama, another privacy-friendly jurisdiction. Both have undergone independent audits confirming their no-logs claims, but ExpressVPN's jurisdiction gives it a slight edge for the most privacy-conscious users.

### Additional Security Features

NordVPN offers Threat Protection, which blocks ads, trackers, and malware at the network level. ExpressVPN includes a basic ad blocker but focuses more on core VPN functionality. If you want an all-in-one security suite, NordVPN provides more built-in tools.

## Streaming and Geo-Unblocking

### Netflix and Major Platforms

Both VPNs reliably unblock Netflix libraries from multiple regions, including the US, UK, Japan, and others. ExpressVPN has a longer track record of consistent access, but NordVPN has caught up significantly in 2026 with dedicated streaming-optimized servers.

### Other Streaming Services

For Disney+, Hulu, BBC iPlayer, and Amazon Prime Video, both services perform well. ExpressVPN tends to work more reliably with BBC iPlayer, while NordVPN excels at accessing Asian streaming platforms like Viki and regional Netflix catalogs.

## Pricing and Value

### Subscription Costs

This is where the comparison becomes clear. NordVPN is significantly cheaper, especially on longer plans. A two-year subscription can cost as little as $3-4 per month, while ExpressVPN typically runs $6-8 per month even on annual plans.

### Free Trials and Money-Back Guarantees

ExpressVPN offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. NordVPN provides the same 30-day guarantee plus occasional free trial promotions through mobile app stores. Both allow you to test the service risk-free.

### Simultaneous Connections

NordVPN allows up to 10 simultaneous device connections, while ExpressVPN supports 8. For families or users with many devices, NordVPN offers better value here.

## User Experience and Apps

### Interface Design

ExpressVPN wins on simplicity. Its app is clean, intuitive, and perfect for VPN beginners. NordVPN's interface is more feature-rich but can feel slightly overwhelming at first, though it's well-organized once you learn the layout.

### Platform Support

Both support Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and router installations. ExpressVPN has a slight edge with its router app, making it easier to protect all home devices without individual installations.

## Customer Support

### Live Chat and Response Times

Both offer 24/7 live chat support. ExpressVPN's agents tend to respond slightly faster (under 30 seconds), while NordVPN averages 1-2 minutes. Both provide knowledgeable, helpful support.

### Knowledge Base and Tutorials

NordVPN has a more extensive library of guides and tutorials, covering everything from basic setup to advanced configurations. ExpressVPN's resources are adequate but less comprehensive.

## Final Verdict

### Who Should Choose NordVPN?

NordVPN is the better choice if you want maximum value, a larger server network, more simultaneous connections, and built-in security features like Threat Protection. It's ideal for budget-conscious users who don't want to compromise on quality.

### Who Should Choose ExpressVPN?

ExpressVPN suits users who prioritize simplicity, proven privacy jurisdiction, and consistent streaming access. It's perfect for beginners or those willing to pay a premium for a polished, no-fuss experience.

## FAQ

**Which VPN is faster in 2026?**
Both are extremely fast, but ExpressVPN's Lightway protocol holds a slight edge in raw speed tests, while NordVPN's NordLynx is very close behind.

**Is NordVPN cheaper than ExpressVPN?**
Yes, NordVPN is significantly more affordable, especially on long-term plans, often costing half the price of ExpressVPN.

**Can both VPNs unblock Netflix?**
Yes, both reliably unblock Netflix and other major streaming platforms, though ExpressVPN has a slight edge with BBC iPlayer access.
